rationale: Repairs the unstyled native icon field left by #988 in the current beta line and the activity-source manual-field spacing introduced by #977. The extra settings focus ring belongs to the #976 beta redesign. Stable v1.81.0 still used the visible outer icon-field border and had no manual activity source; omit these beta follow-ups from the stable user changelog and milestone.

summary.ru: Исправлены оформление выбора иконки и отступ ручного значения активности в настройках устройства.
summary.en: Fixed icon-picker styling and manual activity-value spacing in device settings.
